rationale: S-0009-03 proposes calibrating active Nav / Kv / Ih densities to match Poleg-Polsky 2016 spike shape and distal Ih sag. Active dendritic conductances are the explicit RQ4 focus, which the project sequencing places after a working multi-spike substrate exists. The from-scratch wave currently uses passive dendrites by design. Reprioritising from high to medium until RQ4 becomes the active focus.
